title: Audit dynamic tag field binding and preset persistence
description: Analyze how each Content > Filters row should bind to a field through Elementor dynamic tags and how that binding survives preset save/load.
objective: Make the filter key/source contract Elementor-native without losing saved preset integrity.
expected_outputs: Risk list for sanitization, migration, import, and preset linking
Recommended implementation approach for per-filter dynamic field binding
acceptance_criteria: The audit treats dynamic tag binding as part of each filter row, not as a global widget setting.
The audit explains how saved presets preserve or resolve dynamic tag references.
The audit identifies what must be stored, sanitized, migrated, and rendered.
The audit flags any Elementor API dependency that could break on update.
verification: Findings cite local Elementor source or plugin source.
No preset schema changes are implemented by this task.

budgets.context_budget: Elementor controls, dynamic tags, preset storage, REST save path
budgets.research_budget: local Elementor source and plugin code

risks: Dynamic tags are sensitive because a stored preset can outlive the page context that originally resolved the tag.
